title: fractal-ann-diagnostics: Intrinsic-dimension descriptors for predicting ANN index failure modes
description: A diagnostic tool that ingests a vector dataset, computes a panel of intrinsic-dimension and fractal descriptors (correlation dimension D2, local intrinsic dimensionality distribution, multifractal spectrum width on graph distances), and outputs a workload-classed recommendation among HNSW, IVF, flat-NSW, and DiskANN, with a calibrated estimate of recall degradation under default parameters. Evaluated on the ANN-benchmarks corpus. Part of the broader fractal-indexing research program; H3 pivot from the May 2026 research plan.
